title: Non-One-Hot Grant on Reset Exit (Missing Reset)
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [SVA_XZ] gnt is 4'bxxxx at posedge clk after reset release
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  gnt <= next_gnt;  // No reset branch — gnt starts as X
testbench: initial begin rst_n = 0; req = 2'b11; #20 rst_n = 1; end
expected_root_cause: The grant register (gnt) has no reset branch in its always_ff block, so its value is 4'bxxxx (unknown) from power-on until the first valid arbitration cycle.
description: The grant register has no reset assignment; after power-on its value is X, which propagates to all downstream logic before the first valid arbitration cycle.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [SVA_XZ] gnt is 4'bxxxx at posedge clk after reset release
success_log: gnt=4'h0 on first posedge clk after rst_n asserts. First valid grant on next arbitration.
